landcats.creator: Presto
landcats.name: Shell the Sheridan
landcats.description:
Shell (nickname: Shelly) is a former airborne tank-type reconnaissance CATS from the special operations forces. With his rapid infiltration capabilities and heavy armament, he was deployed in numerous missions. He takes pride in those days, holding great honor in having served as a member of one of the finest airborne reconnaissance units. After the end of the Cold War, he formally went through the retirement process and stepped away from the battlefield.

Following his retirement, he transitioned into the role of an instructor, training new airborne soldiers. Thanks to his past experience operating across multiple countries, he naturally developed a fondness for travel. However, upon leaving active duty as an operational unit, he was required to return all of his visual data recording equipment. This, in turn, sparked a desire to once again see the world directly with his own eyes. Around this time, HEMET invited him to join Oshitoky Logistics, and through this opportunity, Shelly began a new journey, traveling the world alongside the team.

He is now a member of Tokis, serving as a reliable guide for the group. Calm and composed by nature, he occasionally clashes with the hot-headed VEE, though in terms of combat ability, Shell’s superior skill allows him to subdue such conflicts swiftly.

equipment.name: 155 Gun-Launcher System 'Little Cat'
equipment.description: It is a 155mm gun-launcher system developed in the United States for airborne-deployed CATS. A first-generation CATS weapon, it was created by upgrading an existing service launcher and remaking it into a personal armament. Shell removed the stock to improve mobility and calls this variant the 'Little Kitten.'

equipment.name: MBHS-Multifunctional boonie hat system
equipment.description: MBHS was developed for airborne-deployed CATS. It can be equipped with everything from night vision to precision headsets for sound amplification.

equipment.name: CNVG-551 'Window'
equipment.description: A special CNVG issued to the 551 model provides high-sensitivity thermal imaging and night vision. It also features camera functionality, making it specialized for reconnaissance, and it is shaped like a window.

landcats.creator: Presto
landcats.name: Hemet the HEMTT
landcats.description:
HEMET is a former member of the LANDCATS who was discharged due to injuries. He now works as an arms dealer, running his own logistics company, Oshitoky Logistics. Though small in scale, the group operates like mercenaries and is frequently hired thanks to their solid reputation and skill. Far from being an ordinary shipping service, they specialize in conflict-zone logistics — delivering everything from perfectly ordinary, safe supplies to high-risk materials, whether into war-torn regions or peaceful territories alike.

HEMET wears a tarp-like device resembling pants to conceal his injuries, and he reacts with extreme anger if anyone tries to remove it. Beneath it, his old body made of discontinued parts gives off a bizarre impression, which seems to be connected to his phobia of PROTOs.

Upon his discharge, he returned his Crewmate, a decision he sometimes regrets when he feels its absence. His personality changes noticeably depending on whether he’s wearing his glasses — without them, he becomes cheerful and laid back, but when he puts them on, he turns serious and nerdy.

equipment.name: HEMTTIA 150
equipment.description: It is a type of backpack developed by Hemet that uses its own tail for fastening. A branded product of Hemet, it is designed for use by CATS with tails made of cords, like Hemet’s.

equipment.name: CNVG-88 'NERDY'
equipment.description: It is a pair of night vision and thermal goggles developed by Hemet, called Nedry, which look like glasses. They give off a nerdy appearance.

landcats.creator: Presto
landcats.name: Vee the Humvee
landcats.description:
VEE is another member of the LANDCATS who, like HEMET, transitioned from the regular army to a private enterprise. He currently works at OSHITOKY LOGISTICS and has a long-standing history with HEMET, having worked with him since before their current venture. As a result, the two have great chemistry and work well together.

He has a fiery personality and tends to rush into things, but HEMET usually steps in to keep him in check. VEE sees HEMET like an older brother, though he sometimes gets too ahead of himself. In fact, as proof of this impulsiveness, he’s gone as far as tattooing the company logo on what he personally considers his most sensitive body part.

VEE previously served as an infantry support CATS, and after joining the company, he now operates as HEMET’s escort vehicle. He loves close-quarters, hand-to-hand combat the most, but due to the high cost of repairing his parts afterward, HEMET constantly finds himself stressed out over it.

equipment.name: CLAW System
equipment.description: This is a combat knife designed like a cat’s claw, serving as auxiliary equipment for lightweight CATS that engage in hand-to-hand combat. Lightweight CATS are required to use the knife, but since it is a retractable blade integrated with the hand, it allows for a wide variety of attacks in emergencies.

equipment.name: CVS-7 'Mono eye'
equipment.description: This CVS is an auxiliary device designed primarily for CATS with damaged eyes. It is mounted on one side and compensates for vision during combat, providing thermal imaging and night vision. It is typically operated by infantry-unit CATS.

landcats.creator: Presto
landcats.name: Bmd the BMD-4
landcats.description:
The BMD is a CATS developed as a modernized modification of the BMD-4 model, adopted under Russia’s combat vehicle replacement program, Project: Zheleznaya Koshka. It is a small airborne combat reconnaissance CATS, designed to be dropped from transport aircraft together with paratroopers for deep infiltration into enemy rear areas. During airdrops, it is deployed individually along with the soldiers and its own armaments.

Although rather old-fashioned, producing engine noises whenever it moves, which it personally regards as a flaw, the paratroopers do not consider it a drawback, as the sound of its engine is said to give them a sense of comfort.

It is currently on active duty and maintains a rivalry with the M551 model CATS Shell. Both were deployed for the same objectives during the Cold War, but after a brief skirmish and subsequent withdrawal, they suffered heavy losses among their units. Since then, they have lived as bitter adversaries. More recently, it has even encountered Shell, now working as a Tokis, in conflict zones.

equipment.name: DBCW-927 'Malen’kiy Drug'
equipment.description: This is a Russian variation of the Double-Barrel CATS Weapon system, a personal armament invented for CATS. It is equipped with a 30 mm large-caliber cannon and a 100 mm grenade launcher.

landcats.creator: ToasTee
landcats.name: Tetril the EOD Vu
landcats.description: An EOD unit with encyclopedic knowledge of explosives, has developed a love for them and the risks associated with its task. Despite having availability for long range and precision disposal tools, prefers to disarm explosives hands-on to experience the rush of doing the job themselves... very much to its crewmate's (and face shield) dismay. This method has also helped them study (and later experiment with) the variety of explosives. Any ordinances that he has come into contact with mysteriously disappear.

landcats.creator: Green PC
landcats.name: St. Ogn. Stanisław the Star
landcats.description: Ranked as 'Starszy Ogniomistrz' in the national fire brigade. Has most experience within densely forested areas, thus needs thick treads to traverse the terrain. Powerful winch used to climb, remove blockages and pull others. Searchlight for the darkest and foggiest nights, and of course plenty of tools in his backpack. He has a younger, but larger, brother by the name of Mieczysław, a STAR 266 within the military with a rank of Chorąży. Stasiek's love for forests has also made him befriend an UAZ 469 in forestry.

landcats.creator: Green PC
landcats.name: Chor. Mieczysław the STAR 266
landcats.description: Although he's bigger and has a higher comparable rank, he's actually Stanisław's younger brother. Ranked as a 'Chorąży' (Standard-bearer, this is mostly done as a reference to a Polish meme) has most experience with planning logistics routes and carrying supplies. Has big treads, just like his older brother, which help traverse muddy and more difficult forested terrain. Whenever needed, can carry a ZU-23 anti-aircraft gun instead of cargo, which he can use relatively well.

landcats.creator: A Droppa Inc.
landcats.name: Helios the HEMTT
landcats.description: A laser powered bane to all things flying designed by an optical technology weapons manufacturer, ICARUS PROJECT. Working as a mercenary, Helios provides a professional level anti-air defenses to any capable buyers.

landcats.creator: A Droppa Inc.
landcats.name: Arbalest the FV4005
landcats.description: A moving bunker mobilized and made practical as CATS. Faust breaks up the battlefield by being an unmovable wall capable of unleashing pain for those who stood in his way. Appears to adopt an exaggerated chivalric persona while in battle.

landcats.creator: A Droppa Inc.
landcats.name: Faust the Maus
landcats.description: A hot headed demolition expert wielding an oversized muzzle-loader. Arbalest's usual solutions to problem is always pure brute force despite the crudeness, as nothing gets rid of obstacle faster than a well measured explosive.

landcats.creator: A Droppa Inc.
landcats.name: Grad the Tunguska
landcats.description: An always jolly and trigger happy gunner, stationed at a secret military compound within the snowy landscape of northern Russia. While always joyful, Grad's demeanor changes drastically when spotting a potential spy within vicinity.

landcats.creator: Karvão
landcats.name: Wraith the Ghost
landcats.description:
A Stealth Technology Demonstrator version of a CV90120, featuring active thermal camouflage and reduced radar signature.
The stealth project was discontinued, but since its still a functional LANDCAT it got called into active service so it doesn't go to waste.
Wraith wasn't really made for the battlefield so they had to install and experimental chip that would suppress all of the horrors of a war, making him able to serve efficiently without thinking of it, leaving him being kinda disconnected from reality and his actions, being positive and playful even in the worst conditions.

Wraith also has a collar with most of the CV90120 sensors installed in it, it serves almost like a silent co-pilot since as a Tech demonstrator, he didn't have one before. It can deploy smoke automatically and can even take control of Wraiths body in order to move him into safety.
The active thermal camo has very limited uses.

equipment.name: 120MM Cannon
equipment.description: the cannon of the normal cv90120 but with a more stealthy look and more protection against radar detection, semi automatic

equipment.name: 12.7mm Machinegun
equipment.description: 12.7mm Machinegun

equipment.name: Claw and Teeth
equipment.description: Claws and teeth may be used  in close combat.

landcats.creator: Karvão
landcats.name: Big Wind the Big wind
landcats.description:
A firefighting landcat based on an older military landcat model, fitted with two firefighting devices on arms, attached to its back.
Its main purpose was fighting oil well fires using the mig-21 engines, injecting water behind the exhaust at 6000l/min

Not a very talkative cat but gets the job done, if there is any, he doesnt get a lot of work and he cant use roads on its own because he has no rubber padded paws so he mostly just stays in one place.

landcats.creator: Félix Auréle
landcats.name: Mikhail the Merkava
landcats.description:
Usually cold and unfeeling, unless he's talking abt The Monolith, has a tendency of spending long periods of time with no sleep, being very methodical. doesnt like to interact much with others

Crewmate personality: Ilyusha's the more sociable one, often keeping Mikhail's bluntness in check

Extra info: He carries a foldable 120mm rifle, a 7.62x54mm PKM and often a 12.7x55mm DShK machinegun. he's often seen carrying around a strange lamp with a hazy blue glow. peeps that get near it too long report headaches and even hearing voices...

equipment.name: 120mm bolt action Hecate II anti-tank smoothbore gun
equipment.description: 120mm self-loading Grom anti-tank smoothbore gun (depending on occasion)

equipment.name: 12.7x108mm DShK machinegun (mounted on the back)
equipment.description: 7.62x54mmR PKM machinegun

equipment.name: Desert Eagle hand cannon
equipment.description: hand cannon

equipment.name: M9 Bayonet
equipment.description: Knife

equipment.name: equipment
equipment.description: PDA, portable Psi-Installation (psi-lamp), Nosorog-Class Diamond Exoskeleton, 40mm smoke launchers, glasses with H.U.D and Copilot integration, NVG monocle integrated into glasses, steel gauntlets built into exo frame, earpiece with backup radio antenna, backpack with supplies and proto's gun, radio equipment, entrenching tool

landcats.creator: Félix Auréle
landcats.name: Artyom the Crocodile
landcats.description: Heavy truck with an anti-aircraft system installed on it, tasked with protecting the skies above Monolith strongholds and bases Commands the Granite-4 Anti Aircraft squad, and is the love interest of Mikhaik Has two AA guns and a radar backpack with missile launchers

landcats.creator: Kiote
landcats.name: Jackie the Humvee
landcats.description: Jackie was made with extra big joins in his limbs for increased flexibility and added power allowing her to move faster and be able to go through more challenging environments. She also has small vents on his sides for exhaust and the body armor she wears also has pouches for anything important like radio and other devices. the middle of her armor has the black void faction emblem that she drew on herself

equipment.name: Main Gun
equipment.description: M240 50 Cal machine gun

landcats.creator: Kiote
landcats.name: Ghost the Karl-Gerat
landcats.description:
Ghost was created when his country was in a war with a far bigger country and knowing that they could never hope to match the enemy with numbers decided to create project O.W.F.P

Or project overwhelming firepower. Where they poured almost all their resources into creating a single cat in hopes the pure power of the 60cm cannon he had would turn the tides of the war. But his rushed construction caused many faults including the extreme exhaust he created upon start up and whenever he fires his gun, this exhaust issue was unable to be fixed as all resources were swapped over to creating ammo for the ghost right after he was completed. And ultimately his country was forced to surrender shortly after. So ghost became a wanderer before he was found and recruited into the black void where he went under some modifications, fixing the exhaust upon start up issue but increasing exhaust caused by firing his weapon.

landcats.creator: Yehnie
landcats.name: Aura the Mjölner
landcats.description:
AURA became a specialist due to her ability to accurately hit targets, as far as records show she hasn't missed a single target. Due to this fact she's known as a valuable target.

She's able to carry one personnel (Driver) and prefers it that way, as she would rather have a bond with a singular living entity at any given time. However, AURA is rebellious, and if her current driver goes against multiple of her interests or wrongs her, then she would immediately seize control, restrain the driver inside, and discipline them. Afterwards, she would work on her own until a new driver is assigned to her.

Should the opposite happen, and she's assigned a driver who really works with her, or she simply likes, then she'll let loose and either temporarily turn her driver into her rubbery drone, or hypnotize them with her intoxicating smoke for the duration of their mission, usually at the expense of the driver's consciousness. The driver essentially belongs to AURA during this time. 

Her demeanor is alert and cold towards others at first glance, but being close to her or being one of her drivers, then she'll open up and turn friendly, albeit still alert. Her mere presence is very much menacing/intimidating, as she's not the 'playing around' type (unless she really likes you). She won't hesitate to mortar strike someone either; it's what she's made to do.

Also. Under any circumstances, DO NOT put on her mask; the effects may be irreversible.

landcats.creator: Null
landcats.name: Felo the Blazer
landcats.model: Chevrolet Blazer EV Police Pursuit Vehicle

landcats.creator: Nicky Ferrius
landcats.name: Leonard the Alpine Hammer
landcats.description:
Leonard is one of the cavalerie Bravo units defending his territory from any adversary.
But he is very friendly and enjoys a drink.

equipment.name: Main Gun
equipment.description: 120mm with a magazine of 4 round

equipment.name: Prototype Gun
equipment.description: 140mm bolt-action sniper gun

equipment.name: Training Gun
equipment.description: hand gun lazer with the lazer tag suit

equipment.name: Utility
equipment.description: Augers

equipment.name: Utility
equipment.description: Flare Rockets

equipment.name: Gun
equipment.description: Custom Glock 22

equipment.name: Utility
equipment.description: Spike Strips

equipment.name: Utility
equipment.description: Taser

equipment.name: Defense
equipment.description: Riot Shield

landcats.creator: Kasichi
landcats.name: Sniper Fox the Paladin
landcats.description:
Was assembled by ScW-750X, and currently become ScW-750X's servant plus his lover. Both are currently based in an abandoned hangar deep within a snow covered forest, carrying out contracts issued by various factions. Their assignments typically involve targets such as destroying outposts or ambushing supply convoy, and collecting information, all in order to secure additional income to purchase fuel, spare parts, and maintenance services. In practical terms, they can be classified as mercenaries, and they are highly active at present., holding a reputation for the lowest mission failure rate ever recorded. Numerous factions have places bounties on both, making concealment and a low profile absolutely essential.

SF-M109A6, armed with a powerful 155mm cannon mounted on his back, capable of annihilating enemy forces from far away with extreme precision, supported by reconnaissance data from ScW-750X and his own AI assistant, Polar Bear A.I. He is exceptionally serious and disciplined when it comes to his duties. However, outside of combat operations, he reveals himself to be a genuinely kinda and emotionally attentive unit, despite rarely showing any outward expression. Driven by an inherently curious nature, he constantly studies and observes the small details of the world surround him, making Scout Wolf frustrate often, especially when that curiosity leads him into dangerous situations.

landcats.creator: Kasichi
landcats.name: Scout Wolf the NC750X
landcats.description: A retired LANDCATS motorbike unit once used for high-speed pursuit missions, now decommissioned as his registration is near expiration. Small and lightweight, he excels in agile maneuvers and evasive actions. With a custom-built tail designed for close combat, he is well-suited for reconnaissance and intelligence-gathering missions. He lives and works together with Sniper Fox, taking on contracts from various factions to earn a living.

landcats.creator: Kasichi
landcats.name: Lynx the Pháo Tự Hành
landcats.description: A LANDCATS long-range self-propelled artillery unit developed by Viettold Military Industry and Telecoms Group. As one of the newest units, still in trial missions, he has already shown precise calculations and excellent marksmanship down to the finest detail. However, being recently assembled, Lynx often comes across as cold and distant. Lately, though, teammates have noticed him showing more warmth and learning to interact more closely with humans.

landcats.creator: ScarTheWerewolf
landcats.name: Scar the Abrams X
landcats.description: An independent mercenary Landcat without a master to serve, he accepts every contract from every factions he met. He once saved a Proto from the ruined Factory and now he with his Proto companion travels around the battlefield to seek more work and place to stay.

equipment.name: XM360 Shoulder Mounted Cannon
equipment.description: Primary Ammo: 120×570mm APSDF, Special Ammo: 120x570mm APHESDF and 120x570mm DUFSDS, Magazine load: 5 + 1, Firing mode: Semi-auto

equipment.name: HC-7 .50 AE
equipment.description: SECONDARY WEAPON, Primary Ammo: .50 AE JHP, Special Ammo: .50 AE AP, .50 AE HP, .50 AE API, Magazine load: 7 + 1, Firing mode: Semi-auto

equipment.name: GADGETS/EQUIPMENTS
equipment.description: Combat Interface Display Unit Goggles, Detachable External Backpack, Shoulder Fog lights and Camera

equipment.name: 20mm M139 Autocannon
equipment.description: Based on the same model used in the XM800T platform. Mounted on an interchangeable modular base, allowing rapid replacement in the event of damage. High rate of fire and optimized for suppression of light armored targets, drones, and reconnaissance units.

equipment.name: 7.62mm Machine Gun (assumed)
equipment.description: Auxiliary weapon for close-range defense and anti-personnel engagement. Integrated with servo-linked targeting systems for synchronized operation with the main cannon.

equipment.name: Reinforced Servo Framework
equipment.description: Provides enhanced structural stability and recoil absorption during firing. Includes an automatic balance correction system under load or uneven terrain conditions.

equipment.name: Advanced Optical Suite
equipment.description: Developed through private-sector collaboration with the regular army. Combines night vision, infrared, and electronic warfare detection capabilities for long-range scouting and target acquisition.

landcats.creator: Espero
landcats.name: Duban the Yuk-gong
landcats.description: This cat is an unarmed military transport vehicle developed for the Republic of Korea Armed Forces for personnel and material transport. Equipped with a simple powertrain, it can carry a backpack-style cargo bed or tow a carrier-style trailer for transport. It is equipped with basic lighting equipment for use on civilian roads. It can travel at a maximum speed of 86 km/h, can accommodate up to 20 passengers, and can carry up to 4 tons in its cargo hold. Its maximum gradeability is 60 degrees and its range is 530 km. A bonnet is attached to the chest for easy maintenance.

landcats.creator: Cernunnos
landcats.name: Cernunnos the PZH 2000
landcats.description:
A landcat that anyone could trust, just a silly artillery-thing that has a cute smile and is described as 'too kind for his own good'. He absolutely loves protos, choosing to have them assist him instead of a crew-mate. But all of that is outside of combat. He is still a ruthless murderer, the 155mm sniper rifle he uses being a tool of destruction unmatched by any.

no AI, only has protos assisting (backpack MG)

landcats.creator: Fishe
landcats.name: Outrider the Bradley
landcats.description: Outrider is a scouting landcat that often finds themselves observing from afar. Very friendly with the protos they're in touch with, they will do their best to pave the safest way available for their team. Outrider won't attempt to engage in a fight alone, but if necessary, they have their 25mm bushmaster and head mounted tows to support the situation

landcats.creator: Redbnr
landcats.name: Soap the Supacat
landcats.description:
The vehicle is provided for infantry support and supplying. It has backpack-style cargo container supposed to carry light and medium infantry supply as: ammunition for infantry firearm, Light and Heavy machineguns ammo, mortar grenades and separated infantry mortars needed to be installed after. His backpack system has a flat bed behind with belt system to carry extra containers in cost of his mobility.
Has one searchlight as his headgear and eye-protection visor.
Can travel at maximum speed of 78 km/h and can carry up to 1,8 tons in its cargo containers (2,2 tons with additional storage). Without refueling his travel range is 960 km
Has a 12.7mm M2/249 Browning (Fictional) as infantry support weapon. Not able to be main assault unit due to his weak armor and heavy weapon, provides only a support role in combat

landcats.creator: Gale
landcats.name: Sglazka the Monarch
landcats.description:
Sglazka is an experimental purpose modified CATS, serving as the platform to test various new electronic warfare measures in a combat chassis under the T-90 'Monarch' Project.

Sglazka is built almost 30% larger compared to a standard T-90, making for an imposing figure to spearhead assaults and provide support to their surrounding team. However, they make up for this with increased space for electronic countermeasures, weaponry and heavier armour.

Movement is supported through the installation of enhanced actuators and mechanical assists akin to the IS-7. Numerous other non-standard modifications have been made, such as the addition of extra weaponry salvaged from closely related models, and the usage of a gas turbine engine over a diesel engine for superior power to weight and lower noise profile.

Sglazka is not a very common sight on the field, either by their own choice or circumstances of their usage. Their affiliation isn't concrete; private paramilitary company association suspected.


Additional Notes: As a project initially created prior to the guidelines update, I intend to register Sglazka under Legacy guidelines.

landcats.creator: Jagdtiger844
landcats.name: Erna the Jagdtiger
landcats.description:
Erna is a Long-Range Anti-Tank Ambush Landcat. Taking hidden positions behind the Frontline, her powerful cannon allows here to eliminate key targets and support infantry. Often calm and collected under fire, she takes things quite slow, sometimes to the detriment to those around her. With an underpowered engine and absurd amount of armor/armament, she gets bogged down by the slightest difficulty in terrain, guzzling Dizero and taking hours to reposition. Once settled however, it takes nothing short of an ambush to take her down, able to break through most if not all armor she comes up against.

Due to her basis, her original creators and occupation aren't known in detail, be it lost to time or simply for privacy. All that is known is that she has seen notable service before being withdrawn and eventually sold to a private company, one who weren't too bothered by her tendency to deplete fuel reserves and keep allies waiting. Now relegated to mercenary work under Delta Industries' C.A.T.S Division, operations are regular and far-reaching, as much as she groans about having to move around so much.

When armed, it weighs 40 tons.

landcats.creator: Jagdtiger844
landcats.name: Klutz the Scout
landcats.description:
Klutz is the clumsy, earnest sort. Being raised as a PROTO Boy Scout that helps around Bluerock National Park, he grew to love the woods. With the tight budgets within the Rangers, only one CAT could be bought, and with Klutz's attitude and exemplary performance, he was an easy pick to be the only LandCAT within Bluerock National Park. His chassis created by Phoenix Lab, and transfer carried out by them as well, a few problems came with the cheap service. Memories of another LandCAT interspersed with his, appearing as Night Terrors and Familiarity with specific places. With a newfound fear of Firearms in particular, his clumsiness got elevated as he got used to his new form.

Being as large and kitted as he is, he's responsible for helping with any heavy labour/rescue efforts within the park, his winch hooks and natural agility allowing him to get through many parts of the park without much fuss (Except when his clumsiness gets him turtled or stuck in odd ways). With his friendliness and love for idle converse, he's quick to make friends with those he meets, sharing snacks, stories, and even tunes with an Acoustic Guitar he learned to make from one of the Rangers.

landcats.creator: Jagdtiger844
landcats.name: Cinder the Churchill Crocodile
landcats.description:
Cinder is a quiet, reserved CAT. Originally commissioned to fulfill an Anti-Infantry role, poor timing and delays in payment lead to her coming about in a time she wasn't needed. Armed with a Flamethrower and Revolver, she was moved between outposts and checkpoints, never seeing any real combat, though with her sensory issues out from the factory, most of her peers considered her ill-suited for battle anyway.

Through unfortunate circumstances, she eventually sought new work under Wing 38, her marksmanship with her revolver and her penchant for burning things down making her well suited towards any contract that involved complete erasure/destruction of a target. Often found in quieter parts of the base, she tends to keep away from any noise. Music, Flame, or Dead Quiet being her only solace from the world around her.

(20,300 kg w/ Gear.)

landcats.creator: Jay
landcats.name: Götz the Gepard
landcats.description:
Specialized in taking down low flying aircraft, Götz (full name Gottfried) takes pride in giving humility to those who claim to own the sky.

As a mercenary, he is often called upon by those who can afford him to protect strategic assets from air attacks.

The bulk of his equipment is located in his removable backpack. This modular system houses the ammo drum, two stinger rocket launchers and his search radar as well as other tertiary systems.

An assisting proto is needed for the backpack's ammo drum to be reloaded quickly but Götz can still accomplish this by himself during an emergency by removing the backpack.

A human pilot was originally intended to be in full control of Götz but over time his personality became dominant enough for him to only allow people he likes inside him. The presence of a pilot increases combat efficiency greatly but this is not commonly done due to his disliking of most people.

Either as a quirk of his programing or as a learnt behavior, Götz takes a sadistic pleasure in destroying his targets.

crewmate: 2 
one proto ammo loader for backpack
one optional internal human 'pilot'

landcats.creator: Apex
landcats.name: Otto the HX3 6x6
landcats.description:
FK-12 “Frachtkater-12” | CALLSIGN: “Otto” | ID: RM-DEULC-HX3-FK012

Heavy logistics LANDCATS operating under Euro Logistics Corp for transport and resupply. Handles cargo, convoy movement support, towing, and field distribution. Can be optionally outfitted for artillery-support logistics (smoke/illum coordination, base interface support, moving mortar/utility loads, or acting as a comms node for a battery).
Has a logistics backpack module, that consists of a pallet-lock frame with rail mounts and tie-down points, integrated work-lights, optional small drone bay module and a rear VMS strip for convoy messaging (“CONVOY/SLOW/HAZARD”).
Built with a large variety of utility features such as a tow pintle, air/power ports, small service access hatches and a right-torso micro-crane hatch for light handling tasks. Retractable auxiliary wheels in calf fairings (for long rolls/stability) supported by paw pads for traction and impact damping and utility tip mounts for winch/rigging support. Compact SMG carried as a self-defence tool, not a primary combat role.
A steady, professional quartermaster type. Polite, dependable, and quietly warm when off-duty. When working, his posture tightens into crisp “convoy discipline.” Uses dry humour and mild sarcasm, but it’s never mean.

“GENERAL” functions as a mission supervisor voice interface, overseeing operations while providing checklist-based intelligence that organizes, tracks, and verifies objectives step by step.

landcats.creator: Nirune
landcats.name: POL the Charger
landcats.description:
General description: Pol is a calm and focused landcat in his work area, but when there is someone to chase, he sees it as a true challenge. Even though his face often looks serious or cold, he is actually very optimistic and motivated. He is a big fan of racing and cars. Whenever he sees a vehicle speeding by, he can’t help but wonder if he could beat it in a race.

Role as a police officer: Pol mainly works in traffic control. He can be stationed on highways or within the city. His primary duty is to ensure that traffic laws are followed, and he is very strict about them. He always stays visible to remind people to drive carefully and to show that he is there to help if needed.

Personality and relationships: Although Pol is quiet and doesn’t talk much, he is very friendly and always willing to help his coworkers. His support goes beyond the police force: during an incident that caused a fire at the police station, he used his speed, area knowledge, and resources to help firefighters and ambulances reach the scene faster. Because of this, he formed strong friendships with firefighters and hospital staff, who trust him to manage traffic and find faster routes during emergencies.

On the road: When patrolling highways, Pol is always alert and excited. More than just stopping offenders, he enjoys competing with those who drive over the speed limit.

- If he wins a chase, he considers it a major achievement and writes it down in his small notebook.
- If he loses, he feels a bit sad but records what happened to improve his technique. This gives him an extra boost of motivation to keep training and increase his speed.

 Fun facts: Due to frequent races and high-speed chases, Pol needs more DIZERO. Sometimes he accepts bribes to avoid issuing fines, using that money to buy more DIZERO for his races. Before starting his shift, he always stretches. Skipping this can cause problems during a pursuit.

He has two ways to start his engine:

- During warm-up, using a pose called Greeting Stretch.
- In sudden situations, by simply running and activating his engine once he reaches a certain speed.

Current situation: There has been a strange increase in people whenever Pol is patrolling or stationed at the police department. His coworker Pim believes there is a group of fans who admire Pol. However, rumors say that one of them may be an obsessive secret admirer or even a stalker. Pol is unaware of this, but Pim always watches his back just in case.(Sorry for the long text, I got a bit carried away haha)

landcats.description:
Aki is a happy-go-lucky jeepney with a route within the capital region of the Philippines, moving passengers from location to location, on occasion moving goods when privately hired. Her life is as simple as it gets with the usual camaraderie with the other CATS and Non-CATS she meets, though usually in the middle of traffic or at a local sari-sari store.

Due to the nature of jeepneys, her becoming was assisted by Phoenix Labs from what was previously as Willys Jeep LandCAT, now its memories manifesting as nightmares and some reflexes that are beyond her. Despite such, she lives her life as normally as she can, thinking that those are normal for others too and choosing to uplift them to help them get through.

Taur extension: Metal Kalesa. Variation of the Kalesa for specific use for Jeepneys LandCATS. Attachments allowing Jeepney LandCATs to transport more than just their body's carrying capacity. Aki's extension allows her to transport 20 more people.
